The repository structure and memo metadata derivation patterns are now fully understood.

`RebuildMemoPayload` computes persisted metadata from content: `tags` from `#tags`, and booleans for `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, plus `title`. `snippet` is API-only, generated by `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)`. `location` is user-provided and not derived from content.

`ExtractAll` runs at runtime for notification mentions. Core extraction logic lives in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `GenerateSnippet`). `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` calls `ExtractAll` and writes results to `memo.Payload`. `getMemoContentSnippet` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` invokes `GenerateSnippet` with a 64-character limit.

`CreateMemo` recomputes metadata before database insertion. `UpdateMemo` recomputes when the update mask includes `content`. `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` performs batch rebuilds, though it is not wired to server startup. `resolveMentionTargets` calls `ExtractAll` solely for notification side effects, not for persisted metadata.

The exact extraction rules from markdown will be noted.

Tags are extracted via `ExtractTags` and `ExtractAll`, using custom `#tag` syntax from `TagExtension`. Nodes inside links or images are excluded. Results are deduplicated while preserving case. Parser rules live in `parser/tag.go`.

Properties are extracted by `ExtractProperties` and `ExtractAll`. They include `has_link` for any link node, `has_code`

## Derived memo metadata: findings

Memos have two layers of content-derived metadata: **persisted** fields in `MemoPayload` (DB `memo.payload` JSON), and **response-time** fields computed when building API messages (not stored).

---

### 1. Core computation site

**`internal/markdown/markdown.go`** — goldmark-based `markdown.Service`:

| Method | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `ExtractAll` | Single AST walk; primary path for persisted payload |
| `ExtractTags` | Tags only |
| `ExtractProperties` | Boolean/title properties only |
| `GenerateSnippet` | Plain-text preview text |

Initialized with tag + mention extensions in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (`NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())`).

**Tag parsing** (`internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`, `extensions/tag.go`): `#tag` inline nodes; skipped inside links/images (`asMemoTagNode` in `markdown.go`).

---

### 2. Exact extracted properties

#### Persisted in `MemoPayload` (`proto/store/memo.proto`)

Written by `RebuildMemoPayload` → `ExtractAll`:

| Field | Extraction rule |
|-------|-----------------|
| `tags` | All `#tag` nodes (not in links/images); deduped, case preserved |
| `property.has_link` | Any `KindLink` node |
| `property.has_task_list` | Any GFM `TaskCheckBox` node |
| `property.has_incomplete_tasks` | Any unchecked `TaskCheckBox` |
| `property.has_code` | `CodeBlock`, `FencedCodeBlock`, or `CodeSpan` |
| `property.title` | Plain text of **first block-level document child** only if it is an H1 |

`ExtractAll` also collects `mentions` (`@user`, lowercased) but **does not** persist them to payload — used only for inbox notifications (`memo_mention_helpers.go`).

**Not content-derived:** `payload.location` is user-supplied on create/update (`memo_service.go`), not parsed from markdown.

#### API-only (`proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`)

| Field | Extraction rule |
|-------|-----------------|
| `tags` | Copied from `memo.Payload.Tags` (`convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators`) |
| `property` | Copied from `memo.Payload.Property` via `convertMemoPropertyFromStore` |
| `snippet` | `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` via `getMemoContentSnippet` — **not stored**; recomputed on every conversion |

Snippet rules (`GenerateSnippet`): walks AST; skips fenced/code blocks; includes text, autolinks, `#tags`; joins block elements with spaces; truncates at word boundary (64 chars for API).

Relation/comment sub-memos also get `snippet` in `batchConvertMemoRelations` and `memo_relation_service.go`.

---

### 3. Operations that recompute

#### Persisted payload (`tags` + `property`)

**`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` — `RebuildMemoPayload`**

```74:87:server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	// ...
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	// ...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

Called from:

1. **`CreateMemo`** — before DB insert (`memo_service.go:108`)
2. **`UpdateMemo`** — when `update_mask` includes `"content"` (`memo_service.go:447`)
3. **`CreateMemoComment`** — indirectly via `CreateMemo` (`memo_service_comments.go:56`)
4. **`Runner.RunOnce`** — batch rebuild of all memos (`runner.go:27–71`); **not wired into server startup** (only `s3presign.RunOnce` is in `server/server.go`)

Location updates merge into existing payload without re-extracting content (`memo_service.go:481–484`).

#### Response-time `snippet`

Recomputed whenever memos are converted to API messages:

- `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` (`memo_service_converter.go:76–80`)
- `batchConvertMemoRelations` (`memo_service_converter.go:225–252`)
- `memo_relation_service.go`, `user_service_notifications.go`
- Webhooks use `GenerateSnippet(..., 64)` directly (`memo_service_webhooks.go:83–89`)

#### Mention extraction (side effect, not list metadata)

`resolveMentionTargets` → `ExtractAll` on create/update content (`memo_mention_helpers.go:32`).

---

### 4. How lists/previews consume it

| Consumer | Fields used | Source |
|----------|-------------|--------|
| Memo list filters (`internal/filter/schema.go`) | `tags`, `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks` | Stored `memo.payload` JSON |
| Frontend filters (`MemoFilters.tsx`, `MemoFilterContext.tsx`) | `property.hasLink`, etc. | API `memo.property` |
| Memo cards in list (`MemoBody.tsx`) | Full `memo.content` | Not snippet |
| Grid height estimate (`memoCardHeight.ts`) | Raw `memo.content` (client-side heuristics) | Not server metadata |
| Comment/relation previews | `snippet` (fallback `content`) | API response-time |
| User stats (`user_service_stats.go:137–154`) | `Payload.Tags`, `Payload.Property.*` | Stored payload |
| User memo map | `memo.snippet` | API response-time |

**Frontend does not re-derive** tags/properties/snippet from markdown; it consumes server fields. List cards render full content (clamped), not `snippet`.

---

### 5. Data flow (concise)

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Content[memo.content Markdown]
  MD[markdown.Service]
  RBP[RebuildMemoPayload]
  DB[(memo.payload JSON)]
  Conv[convertMemoFromStore]
  API[API Memo message]

  Content --> MD
  MD -->|ExtractAll on create/update| RBP --> DB
  DB -->|tags, property| Conv
  Content -->|GenerateSnippet at read| Conv
  Conv --> API
```

**Summary:** Content-derived metadata is computed server-side in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. `tags` and `property` are persisted via `RebuildMemoPayload` on content create/update (plus optional batch `RunOnce`). `snippet` is derived on every API read path at max 64 characters and is the main preview field for relations, comments, notifications, and map tooltips — not for main memo list cards, which use full content.
